## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and the final change. Include before/after examples when helpful.

## Compatibility and scope

Describe public API/schema effects, resource ownership and runtime/development dependency changes where applicable. Note docs/example updates and any changes intentionally left for another repository.

## Validation

List commands actually run and relevant results. Say which checks were not run and why. For docs-only changes, focus on docs build, links and browser checks rather than unrelated application/database work.

- [ ] Relevant source, examples and documentation are consistent.
- [ ] Compatibility and license implications were considered.
- [ ] Test data and reports contain no credentials or private plans.
- [ ] Behavior/contract changes have an Unreleased changelog entry, or no entry is needed.
